Introduction to Reetha Powder

Reetha powder, also called soapnut powder, is ground from the dried fruit shells of Sapindus mukorossi. Natural personal care brands, herbal hair care makers and eco household product companies buy it as a plant-based cleansing ingredient. Tradenest Naturals is a reetha powder exporter based in Surat, India. As a bulk reetha powder supplier india, we supply a fine, even powder that works well in powdered and liquid formulations.

Understanding Our Manufacturing Process

We source carefully selected soapnuts from trusted growers in India. First, the raw soapnuts are cleaned, deseeded and dehydrated. Next, the dried shells are milled into a fine reetha powder 100 mesh grade. Multi-stage sieving removes coarse particles and foreign matter. As a result, you receive pure reetha powder wholesale lots with a smooth texture and consistent colour.

Quality and Specifications

We follow hygienic handling practices at every stage, from sorting to packing. Moisture is kept below 8.0% to help prevent clumping during transit. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. The powder is a single-ingredient product with no added surfactants, colours or preservatives.

Key Applications in Personal Care

Our reetha powder manufacturer operations serve buyers across several sectors. Formulators use soapnut powder in herbal hair cleansers, natural shampoo bars and clay face masks. Household brands add it to laundry and dish cleaning formulations. Because reetha foams naturally in water, many brands choose it as a plant-based option alongside or instead of synthetic foaming agents.

Buyer Value and Advantages

Working with Tradenest Naturals keeps your supply chain simple. We quote clear reetha powder price per kg rates for trial and repeat orders. Our 5 Kg minimum order suits new brands and product developers, and we also handle large-volume buyers. Our export team supports you with documentation and shipping, worldwide from India.

Frequently Asked Questions

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This makes it easy to order trial quantities before you commit to larger volumes.

What documents and quality standards apply to your reetha powder?

We are an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter, and we follow hygienic processing practices. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

We offer moisture-barrier packaging, from small pouches to export bulk bags. The powder has a shelf life of 24 months when stored cool and dry.

Contact our B2B sales desk via the website or email. We will reply with a quotation, and samples are available on request.
